meta.title: AI readiness, in the right order
meta.description: Nebuloz makes organisations AI-ready in a fixed order: diagnose the gap, structure adoption, measure return, govern risk. The framework stays with your team.

hero.lead: Nebuloz makes organisations AI-ready in a fixed order: diagnose the gap, structure the adoption, measure the return, govern the risk. The framework stays with your team.

gap.desc: They are blocked by sequence. Readiness is not a tool you install — it is an order of operations most organisations have never been shown.

items.title: Nobody owns the starting point
items.text: Leadership agrees AI matters. No one can say which process to change first, or what has to be true before it works.

items.title: Pilots never become practice
items.text: A team ships a promising pilot. It dies at the handover because no framework carries it into daily operations.

items.title: Nobody can prove it worked
items.text: Spend is visible, return is anecdotal. Without a measured baseline, the next budget conversation is a matter of belief.

items.title: Legal is the silent blocker
items.text: No usage policy, no risk matrix, no vendor clauses. So the safest decision is always to wait one more quarter.

ladder.desc: Each stage is a product you can buy on its own — and each one leaves your team more capable than it found them. Run them in sequence and readiness stops being a matter of opinion.

stages.name: Meridian
stages.desc: A structured readiness assessment across five axes. A score per axis, a gap-ranked roadmap, and a defensible starting point.

stages.name: Scaffold
stages.desc: The methodology as guided tracks your teams move through on their own — checklists, templates, and validation gates at every step.

stages.name: Signal
stages.claim: Prove the return in real numbers.
stages.desc: Connects to the tools you already run and turns adoption into a measured baseline — hours recovered, error rates, cycle time.

stages.name: Charter
stages.desc: Generates the governance layer that unblocks legal — usage policy, risk matrix, vendor clauses, and an onboarding guide for staff.

cosmos.name: Cosmos
cosmos.desc: Cosmos is our SAFe 6.0 delivery platform — portfolio, program, and team planning in one surface, with AI assistance built into the ceremonies your teams already run. It is the last stage on purpose: it rewards organisations that arrive structured.

shape.lead: The sphere beside you is your organisation. Each answer condenses or loosens one sector. This is a taste of the Meridian assessment — the real one goes five layers deeper.

verdicts.high: Structured. The full assessment would sharpen sequence, not direction.
verdicts.mid: Typical shape: capability exists, order does not. Exactly what the assessment sequences.
verdicts.low: Honest answer — and the most common one. The gap is a plan, not talent.

proof.desc: This is the substance of Meridian. If a vendor cannot answer these about your organisation, they are selling you software, not readiness.

axes.title: Data
axes.q: Can a model reach the right data, with the right permissions, in the right shape?
axes.desc: We audit sources, ownership, freshness, and access control. The output is a list of what must be fixed before any model is useful — usually shorter than teams expect.

axes.title: Process
axes.q: Which process, changed first, returns the most for the least disruption?
axes.desc: We map candidate processes by volume, variance, and reversibility. High-volume and reversible wins first; irreversible and political waits.

axes.title: People
axes.q: Who will actually use this on a Tuesday afternoon?
axes.desc: Adoption fails at the individual level, not the org level. We identify the operators, their current workaround, and what would make the new path easier than the old one.

axes.title: Governance
axes.q: What is the written rule when someone asks “am I allowed to?”
axes.desc: Absence of policy is read as prohibition. We produce the usage policy, the risk matrix, and the escalation path so the default answer stops being “wait”.

axes.title: Infrastructure
axes.q: Can this run where your data is allowed to live?
axes.desc: Residency, retention, and vendor posture, assessed against your existing obligations — before a procurement conversation, not after.

sections.heading: Who is responsible for your data
body: The controller of the personal data described here is [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: razão social completa]], registered under CNPJ [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: CNPJ]], at [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: endereço completo]].

sections.heading: What this site collects
body: Right now, one thing: a first-party cookie named Next-Locale, which remembers the language you were served. It carries no identifier and is not used for analytics. Verified on the live site — no other cookie, no local storage entry, and no request to any third party.

When product analytics is switched on, the site will use PostHog, which stores an identifier in your browser (a cookie and a local storage entry) and records page views and interactions. PostHog processes that on infrastructure in the United States. [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: atualizar esta seção no dia em que o analytics for ligado de verdade — hoje está desativado]]
Contacting us: whatever you type into the contact form, plus your email address, so we can reply.
Server logs kept by our hosting provider, which include IP address, user agent and requested path.
items: We do not run advertising or cross-site tracking.
We do not buy or sell personal data.
We do not ask for, and you should not send, sensitive personal data as defined in Article 5 II of the LGPD.

sections.heading: Why, and on what legal basis
body: Replying to you when you make contact: performance of a contract or preliminary steps at your request — LGPD Article 7 V, GDPR Article 6(1)(b).
Keeping the site secure and available, including logs: legitimate interest — LGPD Article 7 IX, GDPR Article 6(1)(f).

Understanding how the site is used, through analytics: consent — LGPD Article 7 I, GDPR Article 6(1)(a). [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: decidir se haverá banner de consentimento; sem ele, analytics não pode rodar antes do consentimento para visitantes na UE]]

sections.heading: Who else processes it
body: We use third parties to run the site. Each one processes data only on our instructions.
Vercel Inc. — hosting, delivery and server logs. Processes in the United States. Active.
PostHog Inc. — product analytics. Processes in the United States. Not active yet; nothing is sent to PostHog and no analytics identifier is written until it is configured.
[[DADO NECESSÁRIO: confirmar se Resend (envio de e-mail do formulário) e Sentry (monitoramento de erros) estarão ativos em produção — hoje o formulário não envia e o Sentry não tem DSN configurada]]

sections.heading: International transfer
body: The providers above process data outside Brazil and outside the European Economic Area. Transfers rely on Standard Contractual Clauses and on the safeguards each provider publishes, as permitted by Article 33 of the LGPD and Chapter V of the GDPR.
[[DADO NECESSÁRIO: confirmar qual mecanismo cada fornecedor oferece no contrato assinado, e anexar]]

sections.heading: How long it is kept
body: [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: prazo de retenção por finalidade — mensagens de contato, logs de servidor, dados de analytics. A LGPD exige eliminação ao fim da finalidade, então cada um precisa de um prazo declarado.]]

sections.heading: Your rights
body: Article 18 of the LGPD gives you the right to confirm that we process your data, to access it, to correct it, to anonymise, block or delete unnecessary or excessive data, to port it, to delete data processed under consent, to know who we share it with, to be told the consequences of refusing consent, and to withdraw consent.
Under the GDPR you also have the right to restrict processing, to object, and to lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority.
To exercise any of these, write to [[DADO NECESSÁRIO: e-mail do encarregado]]. We answer within the period the law sets. In Brazil you may also complain to the ANPD.

sections.heading: Cookies and similar technologies
body: Today the site sets one thing in your browser: the Next-Locale cookie described above. There is no analytics identifier, no advertising cookie and no third-party script.
If analytics is switched on later, it will add one identifier. You can clear it from your browser settings, and blocking it does not affect how the site works.

sections.heading: Security
body: The site is served only over HTTPS. Access to the systems behind it is restricted to people who need it.
